Step into the pages of a real-life fairytale at Neuschwanstein Castle in the Bavarian Alps. Perched above the village of Füssen, this iconic landmark feels as though it was lifted straight from a storybook — and in many ways, it was. When Walt Disney visited in 1935, Neuschwanstein became the inspiration for Cinderella Castle at Walt Disney World, shaping the magic we know today.

Wander through grand halls, gaze out across rolling countryside, and let yourself be swept into a world where dreams and imagination meet. This enchanting castle is just one of many places in Germany where fairytale landscapes come to life.

Every great story deserves a magical setting, and at Walt Disney World’s Magic Kingdom, Cinderella Castle stands as the heart of the tale. Serving as the grand gateway to Fantasyland, the castle brings the beloved story to life through dazzling hand-crafted mosaics and the opportunity to dine inside at Cinderella’s Royal Table.

Whether you're reliving a classic or writing a brand-new adventure, this is where your own Disney story begins.
